text:
Sqlpipe moves data from Postgres to S3 through three components:

- A reader process
- A converter process
- An uploader process

The reader process streams rows from Postgres in batches. Each batch is a group of rows that the reader reads at one time.

The converter process turns each batch into a Parquet row group. A Parquet row group is a block of column data that the converter builds from one batch.

The uploader process writes each row group to S3 as a multipart object. A multipart object is a file that S3 stores as separate parts. If an upload fails, the uploader retries the upload.

The three processes run as a pipeline. The reader passes each batch to the converter, and the converter passes each row group to the uploader.
